notes: This manifest describes the unchanged PupateToken and PupateHook for Ethereum mainnet. Token: 1,000,000,000 PUPATE at 18 decimals, minted once to its deployer; zero-argument constructor; no owner, mint, pause, tax, transfer limit or blacklist. burn and burnFrom only reduce supply. Supply and the 85% pool allocation are set by the separate launch policy, not this manifest. Hook constructor: $poolManager, Cocoon sink 0x0add7b9584cd73cef21b39014e3ff6077be53441, and the named 48-hour TimelockController owner 0x8be826082c0fbaec485048aa26ef42ac147898ec. Permissions match getHookPermissions, flags 0x18CC; the constructor validates the deployed address, requiring a mined CREATE2 salt. The first native-ETH pool initialized on the hook is the immutable launch pool. Swaps in that pool pay tax on the ETH side: initially 6% on sells; buys start at 99% and fall continuously by one percentage point per minute to the standing rate after about 93 minutes. The owner can only lower the standing tax and transfer ownership; it cannot raise tax, change the sink or change the pool. Swaps sent by Cocoon are exempt. Tax is collected inside the swap as PoolManager ERC-6909 claims; swap callbacks call only PoolManager and move no ETH. Taxed swaps specifying ETH revert PartialFill unless fully filled. Permissionless flush redeems claims and sends the entire hook ETH balance to Cocoon.depositTax. Liquidity can be added only to the launch pool during its initialization transaction, using an EIP-1153 mark. Deploy, initialize and seed atomically. Later transactions, including in the same block, cannot add liquidity; removal and fee collection are ungated. Known retained residual: the mark identifies no account, so other code gaining control inside the opening transaction can also add liquidity. Pool: native ETH, LP fee 12500, tick spacing 60. initialPrice is the required reference value 2^96; the deployer derives the actual opening price from the separate policy valuation of 10 ETH for the whole supply. Cocoon and FloorFeed are already deployed and are not deployed by this manifest. PostLaunch wires the new pool, creates/funds 12-month vesting for the wallet allocation, pins the oracle question, and transfers Cocoon and FloorFeed to the timelock. REVIEW: Imported notes-length finding reproduced (4307 characters) and fixed. InitialPrice corrected to the assignment reference. FloorFeed low-report finding reproduced and retained under the unchanged-source requirement: a drop from 2 to 0.02 ETH rejects direct recovery reports for four days; 21 successive maximum 25% rises six hours apart can restore 2 ETH. Fresh low reports block market-price seat purchases and underprice adopted-seat listings. Qualifications: stale reports select NEUTRAL, not ACCUMULATE; 1 wei can rise to 2 after a 24-hour gap, while repeated low refreshes reset that gap. Owner setQuestion with the same hash clears the bad value; after handover this uses the 48-hour timelock. Six scratch reproductions passed. Imported protected-floor compatibility finding reproduced: direct overlay lacks HookFlags.sol, uses a three-argument MockERC20 against a two-argument mock, and requires fail(string). All 11 protected tests passed locally with scratch-only compatibility helpers and the manifest inputs. The verifier must supply its own harness dependencies; no source/library changes were made. CHECKS: forge 1.8.3 build passed; existing suite 205 passed, 0 failed, 10 fork tests skipped because MAINNET_RPC_URL was unset. Three prior reviews are recorded in docs/REVIEW.md; this is not an audit or security claim.
